name: omp-kiwifs-extension
description: KiwiFS knowledge base for oh-my-pi: read, update, and look up context, plus the official KiwiFS MCP server.

omp.description: Read, update, and look up a KiwiFS knowledge base from omp.

url.description: KiwiFS server URL. KIWIFS_URL overrides this.

root.description: Knowledge directory for in-process MCP (kiwifs mcp --root). KIWIFS_ROOT overrides this.

apiKey.description: Bearer token when the server requires an API key. KIWIFS_API_KEY overrides this.

actor.description: Author recorded on KiwiFS commits. KIWIFS_ACTOR overrides this.

space.description: Non-primary space name. KIWIFS_SPACE overrides this.

mode.description: MCP transport. auto uses --root only when a root is set and no URL was set explicitly.

bin.description: kiwifs executable for the MCP server. KIWIFS_BIN overrides this.

injectContext.description: Load schema, playbook, rules, and index into the system prompt.
